request.prompt: Write a complete original instrumental for an atmospheric futuristic electric-car radio station. Strictly no voices, singing, speech, vocal chops, choir, whispers, or vocoder. Original melodies and sound design only; no quotations or samples of existing music. Polished warm stereo mix, controlled bass, smooth high frequencies, and space for vehicle sound effects. Start with an established pulse, develop a restrained recurring motif, vary the arrangement every eight bars, keep momentum throughout, and end on the ongoing groove without silence or a dramatic finale. Cinematic melodic techno at 124 BPM, 4/4, approximately 48 bars. Tight four-on-the-floor kick, rolling rounded sub bass, syncopated sixteenth-note modular plucks, restrained hats, wide slowly opening synth pads. Cold orbital architecture and a rocket launch site at blue twilight; weightless atmosphere over a propulsive groove. An original rising pentatonic synth motif and short stereo echoes. No festival drops or long beatless breakdown.
